description: Mutation sweep over the shadow rehearsal and its execution-surface scanner. These guards underwrite the repository's most load-bearing safety claim -- that nothing in the rehearsal chain can construct, sign, simulate or submit a transaction. A scanner that cannot fail is a scanner that proves nothing.

expected_survivors_note: None expected. Every claim that this repository cannot sign or send rests on this scanner reporting honestly, and a guard here that no test can distinguish from its absence would make that claim unverified rather than verified.
